sourceEvidence.note: The pinned source exposes Android-specific wrappers such as libandroid-shmem/libandroid-support. A direct libandroid.so/AHardwareBuffer guest bridge has not been verified and must not be assumed from those wrappers.

candidateOrder: AHardwareBuffer host broker only if a verified guest bridge is implemented
rules: Extension advertisement is capability evidence, not execution evidence.
AHardwareBuffer is image/memory transport and is never treated as VkSurfaceKHR.
No raw pointer or process-local file descriptor number is serialized as a portable graphics resource identity.
SCM_RIGHTS transport and resource identity binding are host/guest protocol foundations, not Vulkan import evidence.
Host broker implementation does not promote guest receive/import/synchronization gates.
Roblox and D3D11 Present remain fail-closed until the guest transport and WSI backend are implemented and tested.
